focus: پیشرفته ۱ · جلسه سیزدهم · حساب کردن روی کسی

sentences.fa: از دستم دلخوري؟
sentences.en: Are you annoyed with me?

sentences.fa: چرا از دستم دلخوري؟ کاري نکردم.
sentences.en: Why are you annoyed with me? I haven't done anything wrong.

sentences.fa: همش بهم گير مي دي.
sentences.en: You are always picking on me at home.

sentences.fa: متوجه نمي شم اگه اين مسأله اينقدر اذيتت مي کنه چرا اخراجش نمي کني؟
sentences.en: I don't understand if it bothers you so much, why don't you fire him?

sentences.fa: گمان مي کنم اين کار رو بهتره بکنم.
sentences.en: I suppose I should do it.

sentences.fa: گله و شکايت رو دوست ندارم.
sentences.en: I don't like complaining.

sentences.fa: روت مي شه باهام اينطوري صحبت کني؟!
sentences.en: Have you got a cheek to speak to me like this?!

sentences.fa: از دست برادرم دلخورم.
sentences.en: I am annoyed with my brother.

sentences.fa: يمقدار ازش پول مي خوام، همش من رو مي پيچونه.
sentences.en: I demand him some money, he is always having me on.

sentences.fa: تا حالا چند بار بهش تذکر دادي؟
sentences.en: How many times have you mentioned to him so far?

sentences.fa: تا حالا ده بار بهش تذکر دادم.
sentences.en: I have already mentioned to him 10 times.

sentences.fa: آدم نمي شه.
sentences.en: The leopard can't change its spot.

sentences.fa: تازه اينجا استخدام شده، دلم براش مي سوزه.
sentences.en: He has just been employed here; my heart goes out to him.

sentences.fa: دلم نمي آد اخراجش کنم.
sentences.en: I can't find it in my heart to fire him.

sentences.fa: دلت مي آد اخراجش کني.
sentences.en: Can you find it in your heart to fire him?

sentences.fa: از دست کي دلخوري؟
sentences.en: Who are annoyed with?

sentences.fa: از دست رييسم دلخورم.
sentences.en: I am annoyed with my boss.

sentences.fa: همش من رو دو دره مي کنه.
sentences.en: He is always double crossing me.

sentences.fa: همش رو اعصاب مني.
sentences.en: You are always getting on my nerves.

sentences.fa: نمي دونم چرا باهاش حرف نزدي؟
sentences.en: I don't know why you haven't spoken with him?

sentences.fa: گمان مي کنم بهتره انجامش بدم.
sentences.en: I suppose I should do it.

sentences.fa: برادرم از دست زنم شاکيه.
sentences.en: My brother is annoyed with my wife.

sentences.fa: مي گه، زنم همش فک مي زنه و روده درازي مي کنه.
sentences.en: He says, my wife is always speaking from nineteen to dozen.

sentences.fa: متوجه نمي شم اگه اين مسأله اينقدر اذيتت مي کنه چرا طلاقش نمي دي؟
sentences.en: I don't understand if it bothers you so much why don't you divorce her?

sentences.fa: شروع کنيم؟ شروع کنيم. سؤالي داري؟ سؤالي ندارم. شروع کنيم.
sentences.en: Shall we start? Let's start. Have you got any questions? no I haven't got any questions.

words.en: My heart goes out to him.
The leopard can't change its spot.
I can't find it in my heart to fire him.
My wife is always speaking from nineteen to dozen.
